name: fyflow-scheduler
description: Parallel task scheduler with resource management, worker pools, and cross-platform support

scripts.test:core: npm run build:dev && node dev-dist/node/tests/runner.js core
scripts.test:error: npm run build:dev && node dev-dist/node/tests/runner.js error
scripts.test:spawning: npm run build:dev && node dev-dist/node/tests/runner.js spawning
scripts.test:docs: npm run build:dev && node dev-dist/node/tests/runner.js docs
scripts.test:performance: npm run build:dev && node dev-dist/node/tests/runner.js performance
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:dev && npx playwright test
scripts.test:browser:headed: npm run build:dev && npx playwright test --headed
scripts.test:browser:debug: npm run build:dev && npx playwright test --debug
scripts.test:browser:chromium: npm run build:dev && npx playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:browser:firefox: npm run build:dev && npx playwright test --project=firefox
scripts.test:browser:webkit: npm run build:dev && npx playwright test --project=webkit
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:browser
scripts.benchmark:baseline: npm run build:dev && node dev-dist/node/benchmark/runBenchmarks.js --categories baseline
scripts.benchmark:contention: npm run build:dev && node dev-dist/node/benchmark/runBenchmarks.js --categories contention
scripts.benchmark:overlapping: npm run build:dev && node dev-dist/node/benchmark/runBenchmarks.js --categories overlapping

author: FyFlow Team
